findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "redact_pii" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: utilpeek: Redact PII from text: emails, phone numbers, card numbers, IBANs, SSNs, IPs and crypto addresses. Returns the text with emails, phone numbers, payment…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "text" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: text_summarize, text_spellcheck, markdown_to_html, convert_subtitles · Private data: redact_pii, diff_text, markdown_to_html, html_to_text, convert_subtitles · Public sink: redact_pii, text_frequency, html_to_text · Destructive: text_extract, diff_text, html_to_text, convert_subtitles.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: text_summarize, text_spellcheck, markdown_to_html, convert_subtitles · Private data: redact_pii, diff_text, markdown_to_html, html_to_text, convert_subtitles · Public sink: redact_pii, text_frequency, html_to_text · Destructive: text_extract, diff_text, html_to_text, convert_subtitles

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
